facts.business: V B Industries Limited is engaged in trading and investment activities, including dealing in shares and securities, and providing loans and advances.

auditor.name: SGAJ & Associates (formerly Rajesh Kumar Gokul Chandra & Associates)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters on: (1) Valuation of unquoted shares inventory at cost pending independent fair valuation; (2) Trade receivables, loans/advances, trade payables subject to confirmation; (3) Non-traded/suspended stock valued at last traded price; (4) Interest-free loans and advances of Rs 6511.76 lakh considered at fair value by management.

Balances of trade receivables, loans/advances, trade payables subject to confirmation and reconciliation
Non-traded/suspended stocks valued at last traded price
Interest-free loans and advances of Rs 6511.76 lakh assessed by management as fair value and for business purpose
